ava_ebbflow_intcpt.name: Ebb and Flow - Intercept

descriptions.1: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by 60%. Intercepting the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by 40% for 12 second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.

ava_ebbflow_intcpt.rawDescription: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by {0}%. Intercepting the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by {1}% for {2} second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.

ava_ebbflow_knock.name: Ebb and Flow - Knock Down

descriptions.1: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by 60%. Knocking down the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by 40% for 12 second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.

ava_ebbflow_knock.rawDescription: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by {0}%. Knocking down the Defender removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by {1}% for {2} second(s). When the Fury expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.

avx_imn_stn.name: Immunity (Stun)

descriptions.1: The Defender is Immune to Stun effects.

avx_imn_stn.rawDescription: The Defender is Immune to Stun effects.

avx_mysticd_iii.name: Prey on the Weak - 3

descriptions.1: The Defender gains 3% of their Max Power each time a Buff is Nullified or expires off the Attacker. Armor Break Debuffs Nullify Armor Up Buffs.

avx_mysticd_iii.rawDescription: The Defender gains {1}% of their Max Power each time a Buff is Nullified or expires off the Attacker. Armor Break Debuffs Nullify Armor Up Buffs.

avx_recovery_100.name: Enhanced Recovery - 2

descriptions.1: Regeneration effects on the Defender gain 100% increased potency.

avx_recovery_100.rawDescription: Regeneration effects on the Defender gain {1}% increased potency.

avx_reinvig_unblk_3.name: Reinvigorated (Unblockable) - 3

descriptions.1: Every time a Regeneration Buff or Passive is activated, if the Defender is not under a Heal Block effect they gain a dormant Vigor Charge. Once the Defender reaches 10 Vigor Charges they're consumed and the Defender gains a Passive Unblockable for 10 seconds.

avx_reinvig_unblk_3.rawDescription: Every time a Regeneration Buff or Passive is activated, if the Defender is not under a Heal Block effect they gain a dormant Vigor Charge. Once the Defender reaches {0} Vigor Charges they're consumed and the Defender gains a Passive Unblockable for {2} seconds.

avx_scndwnd_dmgrflct_3.name: Second Wind (Damage Reflection) - 3

descriptions.1: Whenever the Defender Purifies or Cleanses a Debuff, they gain a Damage Reflection Passive for 8 seconds dealing back 50% of the damage dealt by the Attacker.

avx_scndwnd_dmgrflct_3.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender Purifies or Cleanses a Debuff, they gain a Damage Reflection Passive for {2} seconds dealing back {1}% of the damage dealt by the Attacker.

awes_invuln_boost.name: Invulnerability Boost

descriptions.1: The Attacker receives no damage from their first 3 hits taken.

awes_invuln_boost.rawDescription: The Attacker receives no damage from their first 3 hits taken.

pve_a82_composure_2.name: Loose Cannon - 2

descriptions.1: The Defender starts the fight with a Protection Passive, reducing all incoming damage by 70%. Whenever the Defender finishes a Special Attack, the Shield goes on cooldown for 25 second(s). This cooldown is paused during the Defender's Special Attacks.

pve_a82_composure_2.rawDescription: The Defender starts the fight with a Protection Passive, reducing all incoming damage by {1}%. Whenever the Defender finishes a Special Attack, the Shield goes on cooldown for {2} second(s). This cooldown is paused during the Defender's Special Attacks.

pve_aggrsn_critr.name: Aggression (Precision)

descriptions.1: Every 2 seconds, the Defender gains an indefinite +25% Precision Passive. When they are struck, reset the timer and remove a stack.

pve_aggrsn_critr.rawDescription: Every {2} seconds, the Defender gains an indefinite +{1}% Precision Passive. When they are struck, reset the timer and remove a stack.

pve_ai_sp3_0pi.name: WARNING

descriptions.1: A third Special Attack has been activated!

pve_ai_sp3_0pi.rawDescription: A third Special Attack has been activated!

pve_arctimer_3.name: Arc Overload - 3

descriptions.1: At the start of the fight and then every 10 seconds, the Defender gains a 25% Armor Up Buff and a Regeneration Buff, healing 25% of their Max Health. These Buffs last for 6 seconds.

pve_arctimer_3.rawDescription: At the start of the fight and then every {2} seconds, the Defender gains a {1}% Armor Up Buff and a Regeneration Buff, healing {1}% of their Max Health. These Buffs last for 6 seconds.

pve_bane_1.name: Bane - 1

descriptions.1: Whichever Champion lands the first hit will place a Curse on the opposing Champion which deals 0.50% of their current Health as Direct Damage per second. Whenever a Champion with the Curse strikes the other Champion or if the Curse has been on the same Champion for 10 seconds, it passes to the other Champion.

pve_bane_1.rawDescription: Whichever Champion lands the first hit will place a Curse on the opposing Champion which deals {1}% of their current Health as Direct Damage per second. Whenever a Champion with the Curse strikes the other Champion or if the Curse has been on the same Champion for {2} seconds, it passes to the other Champion.

pve_bloodinthewater_1.name: Blood in the Water - 1

descriptions.1: While the Attacker is suffering from a Debuff, the Defender gains a Passive Fury granting +100% Attack Rating lasting until all Debuffs on the Attacker expire.

pve_bloodinthewater_1.rawDescription: While the Attacker is suffering from a Debuff, the Defender gains a Passive Fury granting +{1}% Attack Rating lasting until all Debuffs on the Attacker expire.

pve_bloodinthewater_2.name: Blood in the Water - 2

descriptions.1: While the Attacker is suffering from a Debuff, the Defender gains a Passive Fury granting +150% Attack Rating lasting until all Debuffs on the Attacker expire.

pve_bloodinthewater_2.rawDescription: While the Attacker is suffering from a Debuff, the Defender gains a Passive Fury granting +{1}% Attack Rating lasting until all Debuffs on the Attacker expire.

pve_critical_setup.name: Critical Setup

descriptions.1: When the Attacker performs the same Combo-Ending Attack twice in a row, the attack is a Guaranteed Critical Hit.

pve_critical_setup.rawDescription: When the Attacker performs the same Combo-Ending Attack twice in a row, the attack is a Guaranteed Critical Hit.

pve_drip_plac_3.name: Drip Feed - Placebo - 3

descriptions.1: The Attacker gains a 6 second Placebo Buff every 5 seconds. Whenever the Defender is inflicted with a non-Damaging Debuff except for Stun reset this Timer.

pve_drip_plac_3.rawDescription: The Attacker gains a {1} second Placebo Buff every {2} seconds. Whenever the Defender is inflicted with a non-Damaging Debuff except for Stun reset this Timer.

pve_engdiet.name: High Energy Diet - 3

descriptions.1: The Defender has 99% Energy Resistance, and any Hit that deals Energy Damage Regenerates them for what the damage would have been. While the Defender is affected by an Incinerate, Shock, or Coldsnap Debuff, the Defender gains 100% of a Bar of Power every 10 second(s).

pve_engdiet.rawDescription: The Defender has {0}% Energy Resistance, and any Hit that deals Energy Damage Regenerates them for what the damage would have been. While the Defender is affected by an Incinerate, Shock, or Coldsnap Debuff, the Defender gains {1}% of a Bar of Power every {2} second(s).

pve_false_confidence_3.name: False Confidence - 3

descriptions.1: Every 5 seconds, the Defender gains a 10 second Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by 20%. These Buffs start paused, but begin to expire when the Defender is Intercepted.

pve_false_confidence_3.rawDescription: Every {1} seconds, the Defender gains a 10 second Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by 20%. These Buffs start paused, but begin to expire when the Defender is Intercepted.

pve_fatalfry_1.name: Fatal Fury - 1

descriptions.1: When the Defender's Health first falls to 15%, they gain an Indestructible Passive for 6 seconds, and an indefinite +200% Fury Passive.

pve_fatalfry_1.rawDescription: When the Defender's Health first falls to 15%, they gain an Indestructible Passive for {2} seconds, and an indefinite +{1}% Fury Passive.

pve_fightorflight.name: Fight or Flight

descriptions.1: Every 12 seconds, the Defender gains an Unstoppable Buff for 4 seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Attacker gains Unstoppable instead.

pve_fightorflight.rawDescription: Every {2} seconds, the Defender gains an Unstoppable Buff for {1} seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Attacker gains Unstoppable instead.

pve_forceofwill.name: Force of Will

descriptions.1: The Defender is Immune to Ability Accuracy reduction Passives and Debuffs.

pve_forceofwill.rawDescription: The Defender is Immune to Ability Accuracy reduction Passives and Debuffs.

pve_foresight.name: Foresight

descriptions.1: When the Attacker performs an Intercept, their Attack Rating is increased by 200% for 5 seconds.

pve_foresight.rawDescription: When the Attacker performs an Intercept, their Attack Rating is increased by {1}% for {2} seconds.

pve_frwrd.name: Always Forward

descriptions.1: The Defender cannot heal above the amount of Health they started the fight with.

pve_frwrd.rawDescription: The Defender cannot heal above the amount of Health they started the fight with.

pve_gooddef.name: A Good Defense

descriptions.1: The Attacker’s Well-Timed Blocks place a random Debuff from Weakness, Armor Break, Suppression, or Disorient on the Defender for 13 second(s). Each time the Attacker Dodges an Attack, place a random Buff from Fury, Armor Up, Power Gain, or Precision on the Attacker for 13 second(s).

pve_gooddef.rawDescription: The Attacker’s Well-Timed Blocks place a random Debuff from Weakness, Armor Break, Suppression, or Disorient on the Defender for {2} second(s). Each time the Attacker Dodges an Attack, place a random Buff from Fury, Armor Up, Power Gain, or Precision on the Attacker for {2} second(s).

pve_hale_and_hearty_ii.name: Hale and Hearty - 2

descriptions.1: Whenever the Attacker gains a Bar of Power, the Defender gains a Regeneration Buff healing 6% of their max Health over 8 seconds. This Regeneration Buff is removed early if the Defender is knocked down with a Heavy Attack.

pve_hale_and_hearty_ii.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker gains a Bar of Power, the Defender gains a Regeneration Buff healing {1}% of their max Health over 8 seconds. This Regeneration Buff is removed early if the Defender is knocked down with a Heavy Attack.

pve_healorhide.name: Heal or Hide

descriptions.1: Every 12 seconds, the Defender gains a Regeneration Buff restoring 10% of their Max Health over 5 seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Attacker gains Regeneration instead.

pve_healorhide.rawDescription: Every {2} seconds, the Defender gains a Regeneration Buff restoring {1}% of their Max Health over {0} seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Attacker gains Regeneration instead.

pve_healthy_disposition.name: Healthy Disposition

descriptions.1: The Defender rotates between Stun, Slow and Heal Block Immunity every 8 seconds.

pve_healthy_disposition.rawDescription: The Defender rotates between Stun, Slow and Heal Block Immunity every 8 seconds.

pve_heavyhitter.name: Heavy-Hitter

descriptions.1: The Defender is Unstoppable during Heavy Attacks. This cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy Reduction.

pve_heavyhitter.rawDescription: The Defender is Unstoppable during Heavy Attacks. This cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy Reduction.

pve_indomitable.name: Indomitable

descriptions.1: The Defender's healing abilities can't be reversed, when this would occur they're instead only prevented from Healing.

pve_indomitable.rawDescription: The Defender's healing abilities can't be reversed, when this would occur they're instead only prevented from Healing.

pve_makeastand_1.name: Make A Stand - 1

descriptions.1: The Defender has indefinite Protection, reducing all damage received by 50%. This goes onto cooldown for 15 seconds when knocked down.

pve_makeastand_1.rawDescription: The Defender has indefinite Protection, reducing all damage received by {1}%. This goes onto cooldown for {2} seconds when knocked down.

pve_makeastand_3.name: Make A Stand - 3

descriptions.1: The Defender has indefinite Protection, reducing all damage received by 90%. This goes onto cooldown for 15 seconds when knocked down.

pve_makeastand_3.rawDescription: The Defender has indefinite Protection, reducing all damage received by {1}%. This goes onto cooldown for {2} seconds when knocked down.

pve_mia_3.name: Missing in Action - 3

descriptions.1: When a Buff on the Defender expires, a 3 seconds timer starts. If the Attacker strikes the Defender with a Heavy or Special Attack before the timer expires, the Defender is inflicted with a Falter Debuff for 5 seconds and the timer is removed. If the timer expires, the Attacker is Faltered instead.

pve_mia_3.rawDescription: When a Buff on the Defender expires, a {2} seconds timer starts. If the Attacker strikes the Defender with a Heavy or Special Attack before the timer expires, the Defender is inflicted with a Falter Debuff for {1} seconds and the timer is removed. If the timer expires, the Attacker is Faltered instead.

pve_parry_v2.name: Parry

descriptions.1: The Defender's Well-Timed Blocks reduce damage by an additional 25%. If contact is made by Basic Attacks, the Attacker is inflicted with a Stun Debuff for 1 second, increased by up to 1 second with Perfect Block Chance.

pve_parry_v2.rawDescription: The Defender's Well-Timed Blocks reduce damage by an additional {0}%. If contact is made by Basic Attacks, the Attacker is inflicted with a Stun Debuff for {1} second, increased by up to {2} second with Perfect Block Chance.

pve_phan_pn_bld_3.name: Phantom Pain (Bleed) - 3

descriptions.1: When the Attacker lands a hit, the Defender has a 50% chance to be inflicted with a Bleed Debuff dealing no damage over 7.50 seconds.

pve_phan_pn_bld_3.rawDescription: When the Attacker lands a hit, the Defender has a {0}% chance to be inflicted with a Bleed Debuff dealing no damage over {2} seconds.

pve_preyfeeble_1.name: Prey on the Feeble - 1

descriptions.1: Whenever the Attacker's Buffs are nullified, expire, or fail to trigger due to reduced Ability Accuracy, the Defender gains a Passive Prowess increasing Special Attack damage by 30% until their next Special Attack.

pve_preyfeeble_1.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker's Buffs are nullified, expire, or fail to trigger due to reduced Ability Accuracy, the Defender gains a Passive Prowess increasing Special Attack damage by {1}% until their next Special Attack.

pve_protection.name: Safeguard

descriptions.1: Prevents the Defender from losing more than 1% Health from any source while being Struck or Blocking Hits.

pve_protection.rawDescription: Prevents the Defender from losing more than {1}% Health from any source while being Struck or Blocking Hits.

pve_resistance_is_futile_3.name: Resistance Is Futile - 3

descriptions.1: Whenever the Attacker would receive an effect they are immune to, the Defender gains a non-stacking Power Gain Passive granting 15% Max Power over 3 seconds.

pve_resistance_is_futile_3.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker would receive an effect they are immune to, the Defender gains a non-stacking Power Gain Passive granting {1}% Max Power over {2} seconds.

pve_risepower_1.name: Rise to Power - 1

descriptions.1: When the Defender is knocked down a 4 second timer starts. While active, each time the Defender lands a hit or strikes into the block, they gain 15% of a Bar of Power.

pve_risepower_1.rawDescription: When the Defender is knocked down a {2} second timer starts. While active, each time the Defender lands a hit or strikes into the block, they gain {1}% of a Bar of Power.

pve_risepower_3.name: Rise to Power - 3

descriptions.1: When the Defender is knocked down a 4 second timer starts. While active, each time the Defender lands a hit or strikes into the block, they gain 50% of a Bar of Power.

pve_risepower_3.rawDescription: When the Defender is knocked down a {2} second timer starts. While active, each time the Defender lands a hit or strikes into the block, they gain {1}% of a Bar of Power.

pve_standrush_3.name: SSStylish!!! - 3

descriptions.1: Landing a Critical Hit adds 3 to the Attacker's Combo Meter.

pve_standrush_3.rawDescription: Landing a Critical Hit adds {1} to the Attacker's Combo Meter.

pve_vigass.name: Vigorous Assault

descriptions.1: While the Defender has a Regen Buff active they gain +65% attack rating and their attacks become Unblockable.

pve_vigass.rawDescription: While the Defender has a Regen Buff active they gain +{1}% attack rating and their attacks become Unblockable.

descriptions.1:
The following Rules of The Contest are active:
 • The Defender's damage taken is adjusted based on the difference between the Attacker and Defender's Challenge Ratings.
 • The Defender cannot activate their Special Attack 3.
 • Both Champion's Attack Rating does not decrease with Class Disadvantage.

towers_rule_dmg.rawDescription:
The following Rules of The Contest are active:
 • The Defender's damage taken is adjusted based on the difference between the Attacker and Defender's Challenge Ratings.

towers_rule_timer_1m.name: Race to the Finish - 1 Minute

descriptions.1: At the start of the fight, a 60 second timer starts. If this timer expires, the fight results in a time out. The timer is paused during the Attacker’s first 3 Special Attacks 1 or 2, and it is always paused during Special Attack 3.

towers_rule_timer_1m.rawDescription: At the start of the fight, a {2} second timer starts. If this timer expires, the fight results in a time out. The timer is paused during the Attacker’s first 3 Special Attacks 1 or 2, and it is always paused during Special Attack 3.
